question.text: Indicate the number of unpaired electrons in $\mathrm{K}_{3}\left[\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{CN})_{6}\right]$ and $\mathrm{K}_{4}\left[\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{CN})_{6}\right]$

solution.text: $\begin{array}{l} \mathrm{K}_{3}\left[\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{CN})_{6}\right] \quad \mathrm{K}_{4}\left[\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{CN})_{6}\right] \\ \mathrm{Fe}=[\mathrm{Ar}] 3 \mathrm{~d}^{6} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{2} \\ \mathrm{Fe}^{+3} \rightarrow(\mathrm{Ar}) 3 \mathrm{~d}^{5} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{0} 4 \mathrm{p}^{0} \quad \mathrm{Fe}^{+2} \rightarrow(\mathrm{Ar}) 3 \mathrm{~d}^{6} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{0} 4 \mathrm{p}^{0} \end{array}$ As $\mathrm{CN}$ is the strong field ligand; we pair up
